title: STD-5: adopt CloudEvents 1.0 envelope for events between loops
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 audit 2026-11-25: `cloudevents` is planned in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --check && python3 -c "import json,sys;e=[x for x in json.load(open('seed/standards/standards.json'))['entries'] if x['id']=='cloudevents'][0];sys.exit(e['support'] not in ('supported','partial'))"
**Status:** open

CloudEvents 1.0 envelope for events between loops. Provenance rows, audit chain entries and fleet posts carry the same envelope (id, source, type, time, data), so any broker, queue or other system can route them.

Lands in `seed/worker/src/auditchain.js` (and its seed twin so every system inherits it). Move the register entry `cloudevents` to supported with `how` paths and a passing test in the same change; replace the home-grown format, do not add a second one.

**Prediction:** standards_supported >= 45 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** adopting a standard nothing in the system reads; a parallel format kept beside the old one.
